title: Owner Redemption Bonus for Vehicles Bought from the Group — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders points redemption, the owner redemption bonus follows the redeeming vehicle's records with the group: its purchase in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records and its plan in the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans records. The redeeming vehicle is the vehicle on the latest labor charge on the account.

| Redeeming vehicle has a closed purchase deal | Redeeming vehicle has an active Kessler Care maintenance plan | Owner redemption bonus |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 16% |
| Yes | No | 10% |
| No | Either | none |

The bonus is a rate. A purchase deal counts once its status is closed; a plan counts while its status is active, and only a plan on the redeeming vehicle counts.

**Hypothetical.** A redeeming vehicle bought on a closed deal and carrying an active plan, with a points value of 30.00: the bonus rate is 16%, 4.80 on that value.
